headline: Ransomware Shuts Down Operations at Joyson Safety in Jingzhou
body: Joyson Safety Systems' facility in Jingzhou, once branded as Takata (Jingzhou), has suffered a significant ransomware breach. This cyberattack has caused a major halt in the plant's production by compromising its IT infrastructure. The resulting operational standstill has prompted alerts that sensitive business data may have been exposed. Efforts are underway by the technical teams to restore normal operations gradually and securely.
